## Overview

This directory contains Enterprise Standards related to business process execution, workflow management, and operational procedures that ensure consistent business operations across the enterprise.

## Examples of Business Standards

- Business process modeling standards and methodologies
- Workflow approval and escalation procedures
- Business capability assessment criteria and frameworks
- Value stream mapping methodologies and practices
- Change management process standards
- Business continuity and disaster recovery procedures
- Customer experience standards and service level agreements
- Performance measurement and KPI standards
- Business rule management and governance frameworks
- Stakeholder engagement and communication standards
